facts.description: This is our most unique tour because it shows you more of San Diego's natural beauty, and how embedded into San Diego the US Navy is. Learn about how San Diego and the Navy go hand in hand together is this beautiful symbiotic relationship! You will make your way from beautiful Little Italy, into San Diego's Old Town where you get a small flair of western and Mexican culture mixed together. From Old Town you will make your way into Point Loma towards Liberty Station which used to be the Naval Training Center of San Diego, when the training center closed in 1997 it was repurposed into a mixed used development with housing, recreational centers, business, hotels, and a few schools. From Liberty Station you will make your way to Shelter Island which gives you a great view of the Attack Submarine base. Making your way to Cabrillo National Monument and the Point Loma ecological preserve, you will see the old lighthouse that stood watch on the rocky shores and light up the dangerous waterways for many sailors and fishermen. You can also stop and look at the tide pools, where all sorts of aquatic creatures make their home. As you finish your tour you will pass the always romantic Sunset Cliffs and into the eccentric Ocean Beach community where there are plenty privately owned shops, but barely a chain company to be found.

You will have more than enough time to stop and tour the Maritime Museum and check out all of the ships, navigate through the unique Horton Plaza mall, and the Gaslamp Quarter to see all the sights of Downtown. From there you can peruse around Balboa park on foot and really take in the sights and sounds of Balboa and even go to one of the many museums that are always open, and stop to smell the roses in our Rose Garden with over 800 different varieties of roses. Lastly you can have a quick bite to eat some authentic Mexican food in Old Town after walking through many of San Diego's historic buildings, including the original home of the San Diego Union Tribune, but don't forget to go visit San Diego's most spooky location, the Whaley House which is officially noted as “America's Most Haunted House”. facts.description: October through the end of the year is a wonderful time to venture offshore San Diego, as this is when we have our best weather and calmest sea conditions. The extended time on the water virtually guarantees whale sightings. Humpback Whales will be the main species of baleen whale targeted, with Fin Whales, Minke Whales, Bryde's Whales, and more all possible. We will also have increased odds at spotting rare species like Orcas this time of year as well. When conditions and time allows, we may also stop at our "Great White Shark Park" to search for Great White Sharks as well! The Vessel These trips will all be on 6 passenger maximum capacity vessels! facts.description: Learn the basics of becoming a safe and effective underwater hunter in our full day course! Disclaimer: There is no course that will immediately make you a top tier spearo or speara because it is a sport that requires time and repetition. However, you can learn techniques that will greatly increase your hunting success, and more importantly the factors to keep at the forefront in order to keep yourself safe in a dynamic environment. The whole day will be spent on our 40' trawler Escapade as we head to the Coronado Islands for its clearer water (usually 10-20' better visibility than coastal San Diego), abundant life, and excellent structure from 5' deep to 60' deep and beyond. On the 3 hour trip out we will cover spearfishing technique and theory, gun familiarization, fish ID, etc. At the islands we will go through some rescues and safety protocols, set up a target to practice loading and shooting, develop fish ID while diving with the gun unloaded, and finish off with some full on hunting. On the way back we will break out the filet table and get some practice caring for our catch, and might even make some ceviche for the drive back! Our guides are certified freediving instructors who have a passion for spearfishing, and the experience to go with it. Over the years of teaching spearfishing to hundreds of students, our team has found a student to instructor ratio of 3:1 is the maximum to be safe and effective. This means you will get a lot of personalized instruction with someone who is keeping an eye out for safety and is professionally trained to help you improve all aspects of your freediving and hunting techniques. We hand pick our instructors and are obnoxiously selective because in addition to being a skilled diver and hunter, we look for instructors who are personable and able to determine the needs of each individual student. They are also a ton of fun Pre-Requisites: The biggest factor in spearfishing is your ability to freedive. You don't have to dive deep, but you need to be comfortable in open water, kicking long distances on the surface, and making smooth dives consistently. If any of these are a challenge, adding hunting with a loaded weapon to the equation is overwhelming at best, and at worst a safety risk to yourself and the others around. Because of this, taking a Beginner Freediver Course is a mandatory pre-requisite. It doesn't have to be through our shop, as long as it is through a reputable agency you are all set (Molchanovs/FII/PFI/PADI/AIDA/SSI). While the best option is to do a freediving course separately, we do offer a combination Beginner Freediver + Spearfishing Course if you want to go that route. We have found this to be too much to absorb for people brand new to the sport, but if you have experience this can be a good option. These are found under our Beginner Freediver Course, with the option to select W1 + Spear at checkout.  Over the past 4 years our team has taught over 1000 students and put what we have learned into our program. Here are a few things that differentiate us from many other freediving schools. Included: Classroom instruction, captain and guide, charter to Coronado Islands with fuel included Not Included: Passport, Mexican Fishing License (~$15 for 1 day), dive gear, spearfishing gear, fish processing, food and drinks Equipment A 5mm 2 piece freediving wetsuit is required, along with fins, mask, snorkel, and a weight belt with ~12lbs of weight. Booties and gloves recommended. All gear can be rented through Just Get Wet at a cost of $50 for the full kit per day (if taking the combo course it's $80 for the course duration) A speargun and a knife. Available for rent from JGW for $50 Schedule: 7AM - 6PM

facts.description: Step aboard Escapade for a 2.5-day offshore freediving and spearfishing expedition to San Clemente Island - one of Southern California's most iconic and consistently productive dive destinations. This trip delivers two full days of diving and hunting, with overnight offshore time that lets you settle into the rhythm of island life: early drops, long sessions in the water, and evenings anchored off remote coastlines. With two licensed captains aboard, Escapade can run efficiently and safely offshore, maximizing time on location and allowing the crew to stay flexible as conditions change. This is an immersive experience - not a rushed day trip - built for divers who want to explore, improve naturally through repetition, and experience what multi-day offshore spearfishing is really like. Destination: San Clemente Island San Clemente offers some of the best freediving and spearfishing in Southern California: Clear water and expansive kelp forests Reef lines, drop-offs, and offshore structure Consistent fish life and varied dive profiles Dive sites are selected based on weather, swell, visibility, and group experience to deliver the best possible sessions each day. Supported by a professional, well trained, and fun crew You'll be backed by a 3-person professional crew, many of whom are experienced freedivers and spearfishing instructors: 2 Captains managing navigation, anchoring, and offshore operations Deckhand who also serves as an in-water safety diver during dive operations This level of experience creates smooth logistics, strong safety margins, and efficient dive rotations - allowing divers to relax, focus on their dives, and fully enjoy the experience. For more seasoned hunters, the crew can target deeper structure and faster-paced drops when conditions allow. For intermediate divers, the trip offers time to explore, build comfort offshore, and dial in technique through multiple days in the water. Same trip. Same access. The pace adapts to the group. Who This Trip Is For Intermediate freedivers ready to step into multi-day offshore diving Spearfishers looking to experience San Clemente beyond a single day Divers who value strong crew, thoughtful site selection, and flexibility Experienced hunters seeking focused time on a premier island The Platform: Escapade Escapade is outfitted for offshore, multi-day operations with efficient dive procedures, ample deck space, and gear and fish storage. Anchoring and drift strategies are chosen to match conditions and the group's goals.

Your shark researcher will introduce your group to the biology, behavior, and conservation status of pelagic sharks, then guide onboard observations throughout the trip. facts.description: Pelagic Wildlife Expedition Duration 6 hours About Dive into the heart of the Ocean off San Diego's coast for a special experience. The primary goal of this expedition is to swim alongside the elusive and majestic Mola Mola (Sunfish) , one of the ocean's most enigmatic creatures. The offshore waters also offer incredible opportunities to witness bait balls and a variety of non-mammal pelagic species, providing a truly immersive encounter with marine life beyond the ordinary. While the focus is on pelagic life, the open ocean holds more surprises. Depending on the season , you may also spot Gray Whales during the winter and spring, Blue Whales in the summer, and Humpback Whales in the fall, as well as various species of dolphins that frequent these waters year-round. This unique excursion is designed for those eager to explore the pelagic ecosystem, far from the coastline and into the deep blue, where encounters with the ocean's most fascinating creatures await. Experience Level Suitable for both beginners and intermediates. No scuba diving experience is necessary, but a familiarity with snorkeling and good physical condition is recommended. Departure and Return - Departures : Daily trips available. - Return : Approximately 3:00 PM, depending on weather and guest preferences. Departure Location: Mission Bay , San Diego, California Expedition Includes: - Refreshments and healthy snacks during the journey. - Feel free to bring your own meals and snorkeling equipment to enhance your experience. Important Information: - Please notify us of any dietary restrictions in advance. - Wildlife Disclaimer : While we strive for exceptional encounters, the open ocean is unpredictable. Sightings of Mola Molas, whales, and dolphins are not guaranteed but occur frequently depending on the season.

facts.description: Plan an unforgettable experience! If you've picked a bareboat charter, after you book, a friendly crew member will get in touch with you and share a list of captains for you to pick from. About This Private sail is a 2-hour morning sail taking in the local sea life and the sights of historic San Diego. More Info - All beer, non-alcoholic drinks and snacks are complimentary. facts.detailsText: Please Note: If you booked a Private Bareboat Charter (over 6 guests), a Captain's Fee of $50 per hour is due directly to the captain after your trip. This fee is calculated based on the hours the captain is onboard and is separate from your boat rental. Gratuity is always at your discretion, though our captains certainly appreciate it for great service. If you'd like to leave a tip,15-20% of the boat rental is customary. The Captain's Fee and gratuity can be paid via cash, or Venmo. ~Thank you! [View Current Captain Roster](https://sailsandiego.com/about-us/) --- We genuinely care about your overall experience from start to finish so please continue reading all the information below: BEFORE ARRIVAL: Please have every guest sign our sailing waiver prior to your arrival. The waivers are all digital so no need to print anything out. Don't stress if you're having too much difficulty with them, as you can always sign when checking in at our office location. CHECK-IN: Please check in at our office 20-30 minutes before the departure time. A physical boarding pass will be required to board your assigned sailboat. Your boarding pass will be provided at our Sail San Diego office, located at 2720 Shelter Island Drive, San Diego, California 92106. You will find us on the corner of the first floor across the street from the Brigantine Restaurant and next to All Aboard. After receiving your boarding pass, you will be directed to our private marina for boarding. We will open gates 10 minutes prior to the departure time. PARKING: San Diego hosts 32 million visitors annually, making parking especially limited during summer. We recommend arriving at least 30 minutes early to find parking or using Lyft. If using Uber, please ensure you enter our address directly. Do not enter "Sail San Diego," as this will direct the driver to our old location from eight years ago, which is about half a mile away. [CLICK HERE TO VIEW OUR DIRECTIONS PAGE](https://sailsandiego.com/contact/) PROHIBITED ITEMS: NO SMOKING, HARD ALCOHOL OR RED WINE. Feel free to bring outside beverages and snacks, but remember you're on a sailboat. Hand-held foods are recommended. We are a federally regulated business and drugs are strictly prohibited (including Marijuana) while underway or at the marina. Vessel will return to the dock and Harbor Police will be called if the Captain sees or smells Marijuana. NO EXCEPTIONS! From your Captains and Crew at Sail San Diego, Fair Winds and Following Seas 2 Hour Sail • Great for Kids! 2 Hour Sail • Great for Kids!

facts.description: ABOUT LITTLE G CHARTER Little G is a multi-purpose custom 70 foot length overall by 21.5 foot breadth Elliott Sport Yacht. Built in Venice, California, she is considered to be one of the finest quality sport yachts ever built in California. The hull was designed by Ed Monk Jr. and boasts one of the most forgiving rides of a boat her size especially as equipped with Gyro Fin Stabilizers. With a close to a 400 sf cockpit, Little G has the size to handle big game and crew to help get it done. The cockpit is equipped with a custom 800 gallon bait tank able to hold over 40 scoops of bait to take offshore. On the finer side, the bait tank also moonlights as a huge teak wrapped bar ready to be sat for six thirsty guests (Coined the “Little G Bar”). Additionally, the cockpit is station for two 1.5 ton fish holds insuring your catch comes home sushi quality. The Tender decks house a 2,500 lbs Davit that makes quick work of launching the 14 foot Custom Greenough Center Console and 11 foot Caribe Tender. Above it all is the spacious flybridge with seating and a view for all. The forward decks are massive and accessed by huge walkaround decks on both sides of the vessel. An additional bow bait tank is located center-line on the bow with additional seating for a sunny cruise. As you come inside from the cockpit, the spacious saloon is appointed with all leather seating, Chef's galley, custom teak dining table and bar await you. Little G is equipped with a first-class entertainment system including 43” Smart TV with Gyro Direct-TV and the sound system. As you go down to the steps to the companionway, three staterooms below include the Master's stateroom with Queen and head to Port, forward to Starboard is the second stateroom with bunks, single over double and forward stateroom has bunks for four. The two forward staterooms share a second head. From the saloon up forward, the ships wheelhouse equipped with the latest generation navigational, fish finding and safety equipment standing ready for any voyage near or far. Additionally, there is ample seating and additional bunks for crew. Little G is also equipped with the finest safety systems and late generation mains engines and generators. These systems are maintained to the extreme and stand ready to leave for Alaska or Costa Rica at any moment.

Your Captain will contact you one week prior to your departure to discuss trip particulars. We will also send out a flyer which will include all details of what to be prepared for your trip. What to Bring All you need to bring is a valid California or Mexican Fishing license. facts.description: Save $30 on the Ultimate San Diego Adventure: Scooter & Speedboat Combo! Explore the best of San Diego with our Scooter & Speedboat Adventure Combo and save $30! This exciting two-part experience gives you the freedom to discover San Diego's hidden gems while offering the thrill of speeding across San Diego Bay. Part 1: Explore San Diego on the World's First Storytelling Scooter Hop on a scooter and embark on a self-guided adventure around San Diego at your own pace. Our one-of-a-kind storytelling scooter will be your guide, cracking jokes and sharing fascinating stories about the city's history and culture. Go where traditional tour buses can't, uncovering the secret spots that most visitors never get to see! Part 2: Speed Boat Adventure on San Diego Bay After your scooter ride, get ready for an adrenaline-pumping 2-hour Speed Boat Adventure . You'll be the captain of your own speedboat as you follow a professional guide through the beautiful San Diego Bay. Zoom past incredible sights like nuclear submarines, aircraft carriers, and more - with every tour offering something new and exciting to discover. Why Choose This Combo? - Save $30 when you book both adventures together - See parts of San Diego that tour buses don't reach - Enjoy the thrill of driving your own speedboat on a guided tour - Tours can be scheduled on different days to fit your itinerary Booking Made Easy Choose your Speedboat Adventure date and time online, then call us to schedule your scooter tour for a time that suits you! This combo offers the perfect mix of sightseeing, fun, and adventure - the ultimate way to spend a day in San Diego. Book now and create unforgettable memories!
facts.detailsText: Check-In Instructions for the GPS-Guided Scooter & Speedboat Adventure Combo Tour : 1. Scooter Tour Check-In : - Location : The scooter portion of the tour begins at 3918 Mason St., San Diego, CA 92110 . - Arrival Time : Please arrive 15-20 minutes before your scheduled tour time for check-in and a brief orientation on how the GPS-guided scooter works. - What to Bring : You'll need to bring a valid driver's license and credit card . factualSentences: Guests must be 16+ to ride an electric bike.
facts.description: Join us for a 2.5 hour guided electric bike tour around the stunning city of San Diego. Beginning from our store location, the first stop on this leisurely tour is the historic Gaslamp Quarter, established in the 1860s and redeveloped in the 1980s. From there, you'll ride your pedal assist eBikes to the San Diego Bay, where you'll learn the history of the USS Midway, Billionaire Row, and The Bob Hope Memorial. Our licensed tour guides will then lead you through Balboa Park, measuring just under five kilometers or 1,200 acres. In Balboa Park, you will ride past and learn about the San Diego Zoo, the Spanish Village Art Center, and the famous Casa de Balboa. This city is perfect for animal lovers, beach enthusiasts, and outdoorsy folks! Our guides are happy to take plenty of pictures for you so you can cherish the memories. The tour ends back at our store location on K Street. Please note: there will be a good deal of street riding on this tour. Guests must be 16+ to ride an electric bike. facts.description: Explore Torrey Pines & Discover Yoga Bliss on The Beach Embark on a deeply restorative hiking journey into the beauty and powerful energy of Torrey Pines with tranquil yoga on the beach. Release worldly stress, gain peace of mind and connect with the magic of the Pacific Ocean. You'll work with a professional Yoga Teacher & Guide as you journey mindfully down a serene trail with sweeping views of the Ocean. Unplug, and learn about the land as you tune in to the peace found only in nature. Upon reaching the pristine beach, you'll enjoy a blissful yoga, breath work and meditation session in sand. Ready to Book? Pick your desired date & time from the calendar and reserve your spot today! Session Includes: - 3hr Custom, Private Tour with an Experienced Teacher - Perfect Balance of Yoga & Hiking - Restorative Hatha Yoga on the beach! - Soul-Charging Breath-Work - Deep Guided Meditation - Complimentary Yoga Mat/Blanket Rentals Hike Length & Difficulty - 4 Mile Hike - Gentle, Beautiful Trail - All Levels Welcome What to Bring - Water Bottle - Comfy Clothes - Good Shoes About Your Hosts Vita Pura Yoga has grown from a humble living room yoga studio to a top yoga retreat and wellness company (TripAdvisor, 2022/23). Their unique combination of traditional yoga science with soulful hiking has helped thousands of students blossom and grow. Now home to a team teachers, healers and guides, they deliver specular results to students every day. If you're looking for a special spiritual experience in San Diego, you've found it. How It Works We make this experience as easy as possible. Just meet your teacher at the trailhead. Your teacher will have yoga mats ready to lend for the adventure. Is This Good For Groups? This is perfect for groups of all sizes, from solo travelers to groups of 15+. Enjoy a custom experience designed to meet your groups level, goals and needs with expert attention from our amazing teachers. Do I Need Past Yoga or Hiking Experience? All ages and levels are welcome, no experience required - just an open mind and desire to grow. Your teacher will customize the session based on your unique needs and level. What Kind of Yoga Is This? We teach authentic, traditional Hatha yoga science. The practice is true to its holistic Eastern roots as apposed to Western "fitness yoga". You'll learn to move energy within the body through invigorating Pranayama (Breath Work) alongside restorative asana postures and deep meditation. In doing so, you'll be able to release stress, trauma and old wounds, creating space for healing. What Do Our Clients Say? - "Our first experience with yoga hiking! I am an average yogi, my husband has no experience with yoga at all, and neither of us are super experienced hikers. I am so glad I booked this, it was the highlight of our trip! " -Chrissy - " I had a truly transformational and peaceful experience ...The hike was beautiful. My guide led me to some amazing Breath-Work where I embodied a sense of inner peace that I have a never experienced." -Sherri - "We had the best time on our hike with Nichole! She was so easy to connect with and taught us a ton. Our yoga experience was incredible - the views were 10/10 as well as our session. Can't recommend this experience enough!! " -Spencer - "The overall experience was amazing on all fronts. Reservation process was simple and communication was excellent. Reminders and meeting point GPS was provided prior to scheduled event... Hike was gorgeous and yoga was perfect. This yoga and hiking event was the focal point of our trip for my wife's 50th birthday." -Charlie - "Where do I start? I booked this tour with some girlfriends and we had an amazing experience. Our instructor's name was Minyan...He provided us with information about the city, the park, the wildlife, the plants and gave us recommendations to check out. And to top it all off, he was an excellent yoga instructor. He provided modifications and a better understanding of yoga." -Denisse Don't miss this once in a lifetime experience. Create a memory that won't just leave you charged, it'll leave you transformed.

facts.description: Experience the Ultimate Whale Watching Adventure with Wild Pacific Whale Watch in San Diego! Get ready for an unforgettable journey aboard our stunning 85-foot vessel on Wild Pacific's 3-Hour Whale Watch Tour-San Diego's premier marine adventure! Cruise the sparkling waters of the Pacific in comfort and style as we set course from the harbor and into the heart of whale country. Our tour is more than just whale watching-it's a deep dive into the vibrant world of marina life. From playful dolphins and curious sea lions to soaring seabirds and colorful fish, you'll witness the coastal ecosystem in all its glory. And of course, the stars of the show: majestic whales, often just feet from the boat! Whether it's the awe-inspiring gray whales on their epic migration, the breathtaking blue whales in summer, or even a pod of orcas making a rare appearance, every trip holds the promise of magic. Perfect for families, nature lovers, and photographers alike, this tour combines educational insight, marine conservation awareness, and thrilling encounters with some of the ocean's most iconic creatures. With panoramic viewing decks and knowledgeable crew, Wild Pacific Whale Watch offers the most exciting and immersive whale watching experience in San Diego.
